title: Asymptotic cycle-type distribution of products of at least two independent regular elliptic matrices in GLn over growing finite fields
author: Gordon, Graham
source_version: Algebraic Combinatorics 5 (2022), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/alco.259; exact archived official publisher native/PDF
difficulty_reason: The proof builds a specialized regular-semisimple character evaluation through parabolic flag counting, then controls finite-field character sums uniformly despite a character index set that changes with q. It separates the trivial contribution from all positive degree-growth exponents and proves both target limits through that new uniform construction. Classical Frobenius and Green theory alone do not yield these bounds; parameter cases and intermediate exact formulas receive no extra count.
source_scope_note: Prove exactly Theorem1.8: for fixed n>=1, k>=2 and a partition mu of n, the unrestricted and regular-semisimple target cycle-type probabilities of products of independent uniform regular elliptic GLn(Fq) matrices both tend to1/z_mu as prime powers q tend to infinity. These two coordinated limits are one outcome. All new regular-semisimple primary-character flag counting, finite-field character sums and uniform bounds for q-dependent character indices are retained. Exact finite-q formulas and later polynomiality questions are uncounted context. The original precisely stated Frobenius finite-group factorization formula, Green complex irreducible-character construction and degree formula, ordinary character orthogonality and rational-canonical/regular-semisimple conjugacy enumeration are named foundations. All source-local flag enumeration, specialized character evaluation, Mobius character-sum and uniform asymptotic estimates remain fully authored core rather than assumptions. Complete original native author body, inline TikZ diagrams, formulas, all statement/proof indices and comments/percent guards retained byte-exact. Remaining open questions in the final unselected section stay visibly uncounted. No mathematical refereeing, counterexample tests, repaired formula or added proof is supplied. The authentic author equation(63), native2102, uses xyx^{-1} in its parabolic count while adjacent formulas use xgx^{-1}; this minor variable-letter quirk is retained and separately noted, without mathematical repair.
